_comment: AWS S3 + CloudFront static hosting configuration

deploy.command: aws s3 sync dist/ s3://your-bucket-name --delete && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id YOUR_DIST_ID --paths '/*'

hooks.preDeploy: aws s3 ls s3://your-bucket-name > /dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'Bucket check failed'

deploy.command: aws s3 sync dist/ s3://your-bucket-prod --delete && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id PROD_DIST_ID --paths '/*'
aws s3 sync dist/ s3://your-bucket-staging --delete && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id STAGING_DIST_ID --paths '/*'
